scope: Durable consumer failure, bounded retry and source failure windows

harness.database: Real PostgreSQL source outbox, ledger, consumer receipt and dead-letter persistence
harness.qualification: Exercises consumer transaction and acknowledgement decisions with real persistence; not a live broker network-partition or process-kill campaign.

cases.proves: Injected failure after ledger append rolls back ledger and successful receipt, delays NAK without ACK/TERM; next attempt commits both before ACK.
Unavailable DB transaction produces delayed NAK, no ACK/TERM, no unverified producer/correlation disclosure.
Invalid payload enters sanitized dead-letter storage/publication, no success fact, terminal transport disposition without successful ACK.
Malformed payload and subject are not logged; terminal disposition, no ACK or retry.
Third failed delivery terminates within configured retry budget; DEAD receipt and sanitized dead letter, no ledger success.
Terminal-storage outage preserves retry with bounded maximum delay instead of acknowledging or terminating unpersisted failure.

source_windows.claim: Pre-dispatch journal failure prevents tool I/O; later outcome failure preserves durable attempt while local receipt rolls back. External effects remain non-atomic.
Source journal failure rolls back actual Sentinel control mutation.
Already processed receipt does not bypass source semantic/provenance validation on replay.

historical_findings.finding: Two tests initially reproduced sensitive malformed/retry logging.
historical_findings.resolution: Sanitized audit-specific failure paths; subsequent six-test run passed.

remaining: Local combined execution is verified PASS; root owns clean-room reproduction and external exact implementation commit gates. Platform worker crash/replay details remain in their owning evidence artifacts.
